findings: Source lines 34-35 still default RISK_PERCENT=0.5 and RISK_FIXED=1000.0 simultaneously. QM_FrameworkValidateRiskInputs rejects both-positive inputs, so a default launch fails initialization even though the governed backtest setfiles override the conflict correctly.

The claimed indicator-readiness repair is incomplete: AdvanceState_OnNewBar accepts QM_CCI results at lines 186-187 without a readiness proof, and CalculateT3CCI consumes an entire QM_CCI series the same way. QM_IndicatorReadBuffer returns 0.0 on invalid handles or CopyBuffer failure, so unavailable data is still converted into a bearish matrix component and can manufacture entries or exits.

CalculateT3CCI calls ArrayResize(cci_buf, warmup) at line 120 without checking the returned size, then unconditionally indexes cci_buf[0] at line 130. An allocation failure therefore reaches an out-of-range dynamic-array read instead of failing closed.

The approved 23:55-00:05 GMT rollover blackout is evaluated from raw TimeCurrent broker time at lines 242-246, with no QM_BrokerToUTC conversion. Its effective window shifts whenever broker time differs from GMT.

The approved card caps market-order slippage at three symbol ticks, but the EA never calls QM_EntryConfigure or otherwise overrides execution deviation. Orders therefore retain the framework's 20-point default instead of the card's hard limit.
